baseline_models.focus_anchor: الجنة is the patient of the passive causative أزلفت.
baseline_models.mechanism: The tree-covered enclosure is not merely awaited; the grammar makes the Garden itself the object advanced into nearness.

activation_trace.role: The covered orchard supplies the concrete enclosure whose location is acted upon.
Advance into nearness supplies the causative motion that reduces distance from the Garden's side.

changed_reading.before: The Garden is a distant destination that recipients must eventually reach.
changed_reading.after: The Garden itself is advanced into immediate reach; distance is acted on from the Garden's side.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The concealment range of ج ن ن is coupled directly to the nearness movement of ز ل ف.
baseline_models.mechanism: Concealment and proximity operate on different axes: what is covered can be made near without first becoming exposed.

activation_trace.role: Covering and concealment make hiddenness an active property of the Garden rather than mere absence.
Approach moves the concealed domain across a threshold of access without requiring total unveiling.

changed_reading.before: For the Garden to be near, it must first cease to be hidden.
changed_reading.after: A still-covered domain crosses into effective proximity; nearness does not entail naked visibility.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The protective range of ج ن ن meets the favored-standing range of ز ل ف.
baseline_models.mechanism: The Garden can function as a protective cover granted in a relation of privileged closeness, making nearness social and protective as well as spatial.

activation_trace.role: The protective cover supplies shelter as the Garden's functional relation to those admitted.
Near standing and favor turn proximity into conferred rank and access.

changed_reading.before: Nearness names only a short physical distance to a place.
changed_reading.after: Nearness may name admission to a favored standing under a protective cover.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence alternates binding and gathering with scattering, spreading, and stripping. Since the focus branch includes gathering by bringing parts close, the Garden can be the constructive convergence of relations after the prior order is dismantled and sorted.

activation_trace.role: The covered orchard supplies a newly coherent enclosure at the end of the transformations.
Bringing parts close activates convergence, not only transport through space.
Winding and adjoining parts supplies an early centripetal operation in the sequence.
Scattered plunging supplies the counter-motion by which the old arrangement loses coherence.
Driving a group toward one destination supplies directed collection.
Making one thing the counterpart of another supplies relational re-pairing after displacement.
Opening and spreading supplies expansion and exposure within the same mechanics.
Removing a cover clears the prior enclosure before a different covered enclosure is brought near.

structural_cues: 81:1-13 repeatedly places a nominal patient inside an إذا transformation clause, so 81:13 belongs to one shared mechanics.
The focus closes this transformation chain immediately before the result at 81:14.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposed motions of binding, scattering, collecting, pairing, opening, and stripping; I supply the arrow from those operations to the Garden as a reassembled habitable order. A live alternative is that these are independent signs and أزلفت denotes transport only.

changed_reading.before: A finished Garden is simply transported closer.
changed_reading.after: The Garden is the constructive convergence made accessible after the world's previous relations are unbound and resorted.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding fire is prepared by intensification, whereas the protective Garden is prepared by reduction of distance. The paired passives therefore encode different directional treatments of threat and refuge.

activation_trace.role: Protective covering makes the approaching Garden function as refuge rather than neutral scenery.
Approach reduces the interval to refuge instead of increasing its internal force.
Blazing heat supplies the threatening field whose intensity is acted upon.
Ignition supplies intensification as the operation directly counterposed to bringing near.

structural_cues: 81:12 and 81:13 are adjacent, formally matched passive clauses with contrasting predicates.
The threatening destination is energized in place; the protective destination crosses distance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies juxtaposed operations of kindling and bringing near; I infer an asymmetry in how access to each outcome is staged. The live alternative is a neutral list of two separately prepared destinations.

changed_reading.before: Hell and Garden are two destinations prepared in equivalent ways.
changed_reading.after: Threat is intensified, but refuge is made to approach: the positive preparation takes the form of accessible shelter.

context_deltas.mechanism: Questioning, written sheets opened out, a concealed outcome made near, and the self knowing what it brought form an evidentiary scene. Garden-nearness becomes one instance of making result and record jointly present to the knower.

activation_trace.role: The concealed domain supplies an outcome that must cross into effective presence.
Bringing near supplies the spatial operation by which an outcome becomes confrontable.
Question and demand supply the juridical pressure for an answerable record.
The written sheet supplies a durable carrier of what is to be confronted.
Opening and spreading turns the record from folded reserve into available evidence.
Disclosure to a knower supplies the cognitive result of the sequence.
The thing itself or self fixes the experiencing subject before whom evidence and outcome stand.
Presence, witnessing, and proximity echo أزلفت as the arrival of what the self has produced.

structural_cues: 81:14 is the result clause for the preceding إذا sequence and follows the Garden's nearness without an intervening clause.
At 81:8, the branchless root is used only as the passive victim-position within the question sequence, never as branch evidence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies question, opened record, nearness, self-knowledge, and brought presence; I infer that spatial co-presence enables recognition. The alternative is that Garden-nearness and self-knowledge are coordinated but causally separate signs.

changed_reading.before: The Garden is relocated solely as a reward to be entered.
changed_reading.after: The Garden is also an outcome brought into the same evidentiary present as the self and what it has brought.

context_deltas.mechanism: Withdrawal into hiding gives way to the thin edge of night and then to morning opening like breath. This sequence activates the night-portion branch of ز ل ف and the night-cover branch of ج ن ن, allowing Garden-nearness to be a phased threshold emergence rather than an instantaneous relocation.

activation_trace.role: Night covering supplies a temporal form of concealment from which proximity may emerge.
Successive near portions of night convert nearness into staged temporal approach.
Retreat into hiddenness supplies the first pole of the concealment-emergence cycle.
Entering a shelter supplies a concrete hidden station rather than mere disappearance.
Night and its darkness establish the temporal cover through which the threshold moves.
Thinning darkness at either edge of night supplies a reversible boundary rather than a fixed instant.
The first light supplies emergence on the far side of the night boundary.
Morning opening like breath supplies gradual expansion into perceptibility.

structural_cues: 81:15-18 moves in order from hidden runners and shelters through the edge of night to breathing morning.
The repeated إذا at 81:17-18 echoes the focus's threshold syntax.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a concealment-to-dawn cycle and a focus branch for near night portions; I map that cycle onto the causative nearness of the Garden as phased emergence. The live alternative is that the oath images remain only an external temporal analogy.

changed_reading.before: The Garden is shifted across space in one completed motion.
changed_reading.after: The concealed Garden approaches through a dawn-like succession in which hiddenness thins into access.

context_deltas.mechanism: The trusted envoy is described through honor, proximity, sovereign setting, established station, obedience, and security. That relational architecture activates ز ل ف as near standing and favor: the Garden's nearness can be admission to an ordered protected station.

activation_trace.role: Protective cover makes the granted station one of shelter and security.
Near standing and favor supply the focus's non-geographic axis of proximity.
Honor and praised generosity supply recognized worth within the relational order.
Presence beside another supplies explicit relational proximity.
The elevated royal seat supplies the sovereign frame in which nearness carries rank.
A person's standing and condition supply established station rather than raw distance.
Obedient responsiveness supplies the ordered relation operating at that station.
Security and settled trust supply the affective quality of protected nearness.

structural_cues: 81:19-21 accumulates relational predicates around one figure instead of narrating travel through space.
The sequence joins عند and مكين, making proximity and standing mutually interpretive.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an exemplary architecture of authorized proximity; I transfer its relational logic to the focus's near-standing branch. The alternative is that these predicates authenticate the messenger without modifying the earlier Garden scene.

changed_reading.before: The Garden's nearness is only a coordinate in space.
changed_reading.after: The Garden is brought into reach as admission to a favored, secure station within a sovereign order.

context_deltas.mechanism: A cognitive veil is denied, vision occurs at a manifest horizon, the unseen is not withheld, and reminder restores what was absent from attention. Together these cues let the utterance bring the still-concealed Garden cognitively near before its enacted nearness.

activation_trace.role: Concealment supplies the unseen referent that disclosure can approach without exhausting.
Approach supplies a cognitive as well as spatial reduction of remoteness.
The mind-veiling branch is explicitly negated in context, separating reliable disclosure from cognitive occlusion.
Seeing by eye or insight supplies warranted perceptual contact.
Manifest appearance supplies the horizon's resistance to concealment.
What is screened from eyes supplies the domain from which the Garden is disclosed.
Withholding supplies the blocked transmission that the contextual negation removes.
Restoring a thing to attention supplies present cognitive availability.

structural_cues: 81:22-25 repeatedly negates false occlusion or corrupt transmission around a positive act of seeing.
81:27 identifies the discourse as reminder, allowing an event to become near in attention before realization.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a reliable disclosure chain from hiddenness to vision and reminder; I infer that the discourse itself produces a proleptic nearness. The alternative is that this chain validates the messenger while أزلفت remains exclusively a future physical event.

changed_reading.before: The Garden becomes near only when the future event physically occurs.
changed_reading.after: Reliable disclosure already brings the concealed Garden within cognitive reach, while leaving its enacted approach still outstanding.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing questions where people are going, offers reminder, names willing and straightening, and nests human willing within lordly willing. Against that directional language, the Garden's approach becomes one side of an encounter: the destination is brought near while the addressee's path is oriented toward it.

activation_trace.role: The enclosed Garden supplies the destination toward which orientation matters.
Advancing into nearness supplies movement from the destination's side of the encounter.
Going supplies movement from the addressee's side and exposes directional choice.
Reminder supplies the orienting signal by which the path can be corrected.
Willing attached to an object supplies intentional attraction toward a course.
Straightness and balance supply alignment of the agent's path with the approaching destination.
The paired acts of willing place individual orientation inside a larger enabling will.
Sovereignty supplies the agency under which both approach and human orientation remain ordered.

structural_cues: 81:26 asks a directional question and 81:28 answers with straightening, so movement becomes ethical orientation.
81:29 nests two occurrences of willing rather than deleting the nearer human one.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies destination, going, reminder, willing, straightening, and sovereign will; I infer a reciprocal vector between approaching refuge and oriented recipient. The alternative is that the final exhortation is independent of the earlier physical sign.

changed_reading.before: The Garden is delivered in a one-sided event with no directional response in view.
changed_reading.after: The Garden approaches from one side while remembered, willing straightness orients the addressee from the other, within a larger will.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The filled-vessel branch of ز ل ف is far from the ordinary force of أزلفت, so this is surprising; it remains anchored by that supplied focus branch, the Garden's vigorous covered growth, and the contextual filling image at 81:6. Render it only as a material resonance of abundance brought to hand, not as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The vessel range of ز ل ف and vigorous-growth range of ج ن ن coexist inside the two focus roots.

activation_trace.role: Dense vigorous growth supplies the living contents of a materially full enclosure.
Filled basins and dishes supply the strange container image that recasts proximity as abundance set within reach.
Vast abundant water supplies the contextual material that can fill a large enclosure.
Filling with water activates fullness as a material operation before the Garden image.

changed_reading.before: أزلفت contributes only movement across distance.
changed_reading.after: At the material edge of the root inventory, the Garden resembles a brimming cultivated vessel set within reach.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The fetal branch of ج ن ن and birth branch of ن ف س are form-distant from the immediate nouns and verbs, making the model odd; it remains anchored in the focus root's hidden-womb image and the explicit hidden-to-near motion. Downstream prose should call this a gestational analogy for a new habitable order, never the lexical meaning of الجنة.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus joins a root branch for a fetus hidden in a womb to a passive movement into nearness.

activation_trace.role: The fetus hidden in a womb supplies a contained life-order awaiting emergence.
Causative approach supplies delivery of what was enclosed into immediate relation.
Breath leaving the interior supplies the first outward sign of emergence.
Childbirth supplies the deliberately distant gestational completion of the analogy.

changed_reading.before: The Garden is an already external place moved nearer.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, a hidden habitable order is delivered into reach like a birth from enclosure.

strongest_changes: The Garden's approach can be constructive convergence after disassembly, not transport alone.
The 81:12-13 contrast prepares threat by intensification but refuge by reducing distance.
The result at 81:14 recasts nearness as joint presence of outcome, record, and self.
The later disclosure, rank, and direction sequences preserve cognitive, social, and reciprocal forms of nearness alongside the spatial one.
summary.what_was_special: The focus pairs concealment with approach, so the packet can change the axis of nearness without forcing one final reading: covered place, protective favor, assembled order, witnessed outcome, dawn-like emergence, present disclosure, and reciprocal encounter remain coexistent.
remaining_uncertainties: The passive clause leaves both agent and recipient unstated, so transport, assembly, presentation, and admission remain underdetermined.
The temporal, vessel, and gestational branches are deliberately branch-distant and should remain exploratory analogies.
It remains open whether reliable transmission makes the Garden cognitively near now or only validates its later enacted nearness.
